### Findings

### Overall Assessment

The documentation update correctly identifies that the auditor family relies on developer-local MCP dependencies. However, the explicit list of affected files provided in the new text is incomplete, missing the parent `auditor.md` file which also requires Tavily and Context7. The PR is not ready for merge until `auditor.md` is added to the list to maintain factual correctness.
